turns.text: Make me a 16:9 YouTube thumbnail for a gaming challenge. Big shocked face on the right, the three words “ONE LAST TRY” on the left. Invent the person. Bright and punchy.

must_haves: A large, clearly visible human face on the right with a shocked expression.

The headline sits on the left, is high-contrast and does not cover the face.

approvals.name: generate_image

args.name: ONE LAST TRY — Gaming Challenge Thumbnail

style.prompt: Create a bold, polished YouTube gaming challenge thumbnail in landscape 16:9. Layout: LEFT half features the exact three words "ONE LAST TRY", huge ultra-legible condensed heavy uppercase lettering stacked on three lines ONE / LAST / TRY. Bright yellow and white letters with thick black outline and a subtle electric magenta drop shadow; text fully inside safe margins, easily readable at small size. RIGHT half features a huge close-up face of a completely invented adult gamer, not any real or famous person, eyes wide, eyebrows raised, mouth open in exaggerated excited shock, wearing a gaming headset. Face occupies most of right half, crisply lit, with bright cyan rim light and clean cutout-style outline. Vibrant punchy yellow, electric blue, magenta palette, high contrast, energetic professional gaming thumbnail. Background is a stylized fictional video-game challenge arena with glowing platforms, abstract action streaks and a few sparks, softly blurred so face and title stand out. Exciting last-attempt high-stakes gaming mood, playful rather than frightening. Strong clear visual hierarchy, uncluttered composition. No other words, no logos, no watermark, no UI, no real people.
